vulnerability_analysis: The TeaToken contract accumulates fees in the contract address. The owner has privileged functions that allow them to: 1) Disable fees (setTaxFeePercent, setLiquidityFeePercent), 2) Exclude themselves from fees (excludeFromFee), and 3) Transfer tokens from the contract to themselves. The maxTxAmount check is bypassed for owner transfers, allowing unlimited transfers. The vulnerability is that the owner can drain all accumulated fee tokens from the contract.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the owner, disable fees and swap/liquify mechanism, then transfer the contract's token balance to the owner address.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address of the contract. 2. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner. 3. Call setTaxFeePercent(0) and setLiquidityFeePercent(0) to disable fees. 4. Call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to prevent automatic liquidity additions. 5. Call excludeFromFee(owner) to ensure no fees on the transfer. 6. Transfer the contract's token balance to the owner address.
